integrity: The proof distinguishes the proved dual-norm and norm-attainment statements from literature-search evidence; search failure is not treated as a proof of novelty.
scientific_limitations: The exact statement concerns the additive norm sup plus L1(nu) on real C(K).
The clipping and quotient-dual ingredients are standard; no equivalent published full signed-measure norm-attainment classification was located in the searches performed.
No independent audit has been performed.
title: A clipping formula and a singular band of non-norm-attainers for measure-augmented C(K) norms
